name: Poison
text: A poisoned unit takes 1 damage at the start of each turn until it dies or is vitalized.

name: Vitalize
text: A vitalized unit gains 1 strength at the start of each turn until it is poisoned.

name: Freeze
text: A frozen unit does not move at the start of its next turn and its ability is disabled for that turn; it lasts one turn.

name: Confuse
text: A confused unit moves sideways at random during its movement; it lasts one turn.

name: Disable
text: A disabled unit loses its ability until it dies.

name: Command
text: Forces a unit to move forward, ignoring its attack pattern and enemies on its sides.

name: Convert
text: Switches a unit to the other player's side.

name: Destroy
text: Removes a target from the board whatever its strength.

name: Drain
text: Damages one unit and gives the same amount of health to another.

name: Force attack
text: Makes a unit attack a bordering tile, usually at random; its before- and after-attacking abilities trigger.

name: Move fixedly forward
text: Moves a unit forward while ignoring enemies on its sides.

name: Pull
text: Moves a unit toward another unit in the same row or column when nothing is between them; damage dealt with it comes after the move.

name: Push
text: Moves a unit along a row or column until it reaches the edge of the board or another unit or structure; a unit cannot be pushed into a base.

name: Reduce strength
text: Sets a unit's strength to a value; this is not damage.

name: Spawn
text: Creates a unit or structure on a tile; a random spawn is always within the front line.
